title: Keep reconstruction degree tied to input precision rather than operation count
statement: In Q(zeta)[V]/(V^[d(n+2)]),d=2^(b-1), factors1+V(Gj-1) have retained incidence degree<=k[d(n+2)-1]. Discarded orders vanish modulo2^(n+2) in Z[zeta], so exact reconstruction followed by coefficient-sum and centering recovers the original phase sum.

body: A bound2^n on every integral coordinate makes precision depend on original inputs. Neutral factors and high-incidence branching precede the manufactured summaries.
